chunks: No intercessor will they have among those they associated (with God), and will reject their partners.
ai.seo_question: Who will intercede for polytheists on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate failure of *shirk* (associating partners with God), illustrating that on the Day of Judgment, the false deities worshipped by polytheists will be stripped of their perceived power to intercede. The polytheists will disown these partners, realizing that the idols were merely silent entities incapable of fulfilling their promises, thereby confirming the monotheistic truth they rejected in life.
